---
title: "Welcome to David Notario and Claudia Mediavilla"
date: 2025-09-01
description: "Two new researchers join the group to work on INTRADISP and RIMed-Fauna."
categories: [people]
---

We are happy to welcome two new members to the group.

**David Notario Rincón** joins [INTRADISP](../../projects/intradisp.html) to work on bird range dynamics under climate change, using ring-recovery data to understand how dispersal varies across environmental gradients.

**Claudia Mediavilla** joins [RIMed-Fauna](../../projects/remined.html), where she studies wildlife in Mediterranean river ecosystems by combining camera trapping with species distribution modelling.

Both are co-supervised with Rafael Barrientos. Meet the whole group on the [People](../../people.html) page.
